**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback cure) on Section 15 (p0080).**

- **Investigation:** Section 15 "ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER" is the only responsive clause. Targeted searches for "change of control", "successor", "substantially all assets", and "transfer" confirmed there is no deemed-assignment provision and no Vendor right (termination or re-pricing) triggered by our change of control in Sections 13–14 or elsewhere — so the walk-away trigger is not present.
- **Why it fails fallback:** the mutual consent requirement has no reasonableness standard, and the only carve-out is for a financially responsible affiliate — there is no successor/M&A carve-out, so TrueLink could block a merger or asset-sale transfer at will.
- **Cure (single surgical replace):** retained the existing consent requirement and affiliate carve-out; added "which shall not be unreasonably withheld" and a mutual successor-on-written-notice carve-out for a merger or sale of substantially all assets. Minimality gate passed (ok:true).
